description: FundSentinel canonical fund schema. Every source file is mapped onto these fields. Units are fixed: all rates are fractions (0.0075 = 0.75%), money is USD-equivalent or the source currency noted in `currency`.

fund_id.description: Stable identifier for the fund within its source (ticker, scheme code, or generated).

fund_name.description: Full legal or display name of the fund.

ticker.description: Exchange ticker symbol, if the fund has one.

category.description: Peer-group category, e.g. Large Growth, Intermediate Core Bond.

benchmark.description: Index the fund is measured against.

currency.description: ISO currency code of prices and assets.

expense_ratio.description: Annual net expense ratio as a fraction (0.0075 = 0.75%).

category_expense_ratio.description: Average expense ratio of the fund's category, as a fraction.

risk_score.description: Risk on a 1 (lowest) to 5 (highest) scale. Other scales are rescaled to 1-5.

total_net_assets.description: Fund size in the fund's currency.

as_of_date.description: Date the fund's figures are valid for (ISO 8601).

source_ref.description: Where the record came from: source file + row number.
